contact.name: Logan Hutchens
contact.evidence_quote: The North Carolina State University (NCSU) Baja team is comprised of 35 students that design, build, and race an off-road vehicle each year. The team’s annual season culminates in the collegiate off-road Baja vehicle competition hosted by the Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE). We chatted with Logan Hutchens, former team co-captain and current Protolabs maintenance technician to get the scoop on the team and how our metal 3D printing services came in clutch for the 2023 season.
